ours-threads.short: Night School's GPU emulator and kernels, built for this film
ours-threads.citation: media/school/threads/facts.json, written by tools/school/fill_threads.mjs from system/school/threads.mjs: WGSL kernels that add two arrays (contiguous and strided), an exact JS emulator of thread grouping, idle threads and memory transactions in 32-byte and 128-byte models, and a checker with canaries tested on nine broken kernels.
claims: n = 1,000 with workgroups of 64: 16 workgroups, 1,024 threads, 24 idle.
32-byte model: contiguous 393,216 transactions for the whole job; stride 8 and above 2,228,224 (efficiency 0.1765).

Of nine broken cases (three kernels, three allowed outcomes each), the output check with canaries misses two (stray writes dropped); the emulator's out-of-bounds store count catches those, and no case escapes both.
ours-threads.does_not_prove: Any timing on a real GPU; caches are not modelled.
